'''Mirror Group''' is a group of isles on West Metropolis Archipelago (C). However, in terms of district, it is located in Sava West Shoal. It is also home to one of the three islands in West Metropolis Archipelago which belongs to Sava District. Despite being named as a Group, it is a "pseudo-archipelago" made up of a plateau, a lagoon and a shoal. Currently, Route 3 passes through this group and sets up support pillars in here, but no development was seen in here otherwise.

title: N-Stock
safeHtml:
The '''N-stock''' is a train designed by "New Horizons Technology" (The parent company of Nazca Railway) designed for Standard Railway use.

Technical Information

Exterior and Outlook

  • '''Driver Cab Car Length''': 25000 mm
  • '''Normal Car Length''': 22000 mm
  • '''Width''': 3000 mm
  • '''Height''': 3750 mm
  • '''Total Length''' (9-Carriage): 204000 mm (204 m)
  • '''Track Gauge''': 1432 mm
  • '''Car Doors''': 5 doors on both sides
  • '''Material''': Titanium Alloy
  • '''Destination Indication''': Full-Color LED, alternating between Route Name and Destination Name.

Variants

Code: D－Driver Cab, H－Control Car, M－Motor, P－Pantograph, T－Trailer

D41xx - P42xx - M43xx - D44xx

D61xx - P62xx - M63xx - M64xx - P65xx - D66xx

D91xx - P92xx - M93xx - H94xx - M95xx - H96xx或T96xxOnly the Sample Car is a T Variant (T9601), other stocks is H Variant.</ref> - M97xx - P98xx - D99xx

  • '''4-Carriage''': 2M2T(D-P-M-D)
  • '''6-Carriage''': 4M2T(D-P-M-M-P-D)
  • '''9-Carriage''': 5M4T(D-P-M-H-M-T(H)-M-P-D)

After the 100th Rolling Stock: <br />D91xxx - P92xxx - M93xxx - H94xxx - M95xxx - H96xxx - M97xxx - P98xxx - D99xxx

xx and xxx represents the order of rolling stock constructed.

Specifications

  • '''Designed Maximum Speed''': 135 km/h
  • '''Operational Maximum Speed''' (Los Sengas): 125 km/h
  • '''Acceleration''': 4.5 km/h/s
  • '''Deceleration''': 2-5 km/h/s

Power Systems

  • '''Electrification''': 1500 V DC (Can be customized for support of 25000V 60Hz AC and alternation between AC and DC).
  • '''Current Collector''': Wireless Pantograph
  • '''Braking system''': Regenerative Braking blended with air brake.

Vehicle Design

Seats

All trains have vertical seats, some have headrests and artificial leather.

Train Interior

Circular Plastic Rings and cylindrical handrails are set up between train doors, with an improved holding position for optimized touch. While there was formerly a hand rail in the middle of the car doors, as it affects the efficiency of passenger flow, they were later removed. To the left of every third door of each carriage, wheelchair space is available. Each carriage can place up to two wheelchairs. Standing Room is also placed at the third and seventh carriage, and seats are NOT available between the second door and the third door.

Passenger Information Display System

A 17.5-inch LCD screen is placed on the car door to play advertisements and news information, and two connected 17.5-inch display screens display train information, including the next station, the destination, the station layout and transfer information. In total, there are three 17.5-inch displays on the car door.

Car Doors

Car doors are 1500mm wide, and all car doors are electrically operated. While the doors are quiet during operation, a sound indicatior will also sound when the doors are about to close to ensure passenger safety.

Neutral Zone

When trains pass through Neutral Zones, the Electrical Voltage becomes Zero, and a loud bang will be heard due to air pressure. However, they only exist in , and other areas are separated using insulators. Signs also exist to indicate the beginning and end of Neutral Zones.

Application

(Also used by , , , , , , , , , during rush hours and for spare purposes). While this rolling stock would also be used by Veloducts during rush hours to alleviate passengers due to its larger passenger capacity, as the number of seats is also lower in this train, this rolling stock is avoided by veloducts at non-rush hours.

Fun Facts

  • As this station is the 204th Station, and Standard Railway Platforms are 204m long, a wall of signs highlighting the first 204 Stations of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division is seen at the east wall above the Platforms.
  • The Red color scheme of this station alludes to Rusty Metal as nails in Public Toilets in Hong Kong are usually rusted.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IvC73un2MHQ&t=1735s</ref>
  • When viewed from the top, the shape of the pool at the Station Park resembles a nail, and the support pillars of this station also alludes to a nail.
  • The Floor Height of this station initially (from Platforms to Platforms) is 40m tall, and is further expanded to 45m (between and Platforms) after the expansion in S3E18.
  • After the Expansion of this Station, the Los Sengas Coffee is relocated to the East Concourse of this Station. This expansion also caused this Checkpoint to become the second Checkpoint to serve six lines after Sand Martin Checkpoint, meaning that this Station, alongside , shares the record for serving the most railway lines when Metropolis Terminal is not considered.
  • Due to Geological Constraints, is the only line that can directly interchange with , and East Concourse, which connects with the aforementioned platforms, only features passageways connecting to the Main Concourse, the , and Platforms, with no direct access to and Platforms. Therefore, passengers need to make use of one of the following to access between Platforms or the East Concourse and the , Platforms:
  • Use the non-entry gate area passageway between the Main Concourse and the East Concourse near Exit E;
  • Pass through and Platforms (Applicable for Passengers), or;
  • Pass through Platforms (Applicable for Passengers).
  • Alternatively, passengers that need to change between and can also consider making the transfer at Welliant Plateau Station.

Nazca Railway (納斯卡鐵路 ; known as NR, NRC) is one of the one-person Minecraft railway systems in Hong Kong. Established on 17 November 2011, it operates free railway services on its servers. Apart from railway services, NR also branched out into public works, becoming an all-around transportation and large-scale construction provider.

Divisions

  • NR Buses
  • <s>Sava Light Transit</s> (Became a public-management railway system, no longer under NR)
  • Terracept Division: Ended, once the largest railway network. 12 lines in total before termination of development.
  • Nether Division: Ended, was the first division ever developed.
  • Golden Division: Ended.
  • Island Division: Cancelled, NR created its prototype of Platform Safety Doors there.
  • Heaven Pacific Division: Ended, was the first time when NR developed two divisions simultaneously.

title: Nazca Railway (Heaven Pacific Division)
safeHtml:
Nazca Railway Heaven Pacific Division (納斯卡鐵路 (天荔分部)), was established on November 18 2017. While it existed, Nazca Railway had simultaneously developed this division alongside Los Sengas Division, and was the only instance of such a development mode in Nazca Railway to date. However, development of this division ended on July 20 2018 due to the release of Java Edition 1.13, and this division is no longer accessible.

Differences with Los Sengas Division

  1. Episodes listed in a manner similar to Terracept Division (With no "Seasons" involved)
  2. Slightly simplified announcements
  3. The line is represented by the first English Letter of the English name of the line instead of a number
  4. All stations are assigned with a code
  5. Stations won't be graded (eg. No "terminal-class", "checkpoint-class", "gateway-class" stations)
  6. All exits are named
  7. Tunnel width increased from 5X5 to 7X7 including tunnel walls
  8. All tunnels equipped with overhead catenaries (for decoration purposes)
  9. At each end of the platform, a manual override control for platform gates are installed.

Fun Facts

  • Some features of this division have been adopted into the Los Sengas Division after improvements are made on it, such as the Nazca Railway Station Numbering and Directional System.

Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division (納斯卡鐵路 (洛聖加分部) ;Formerly named Metropolis Division), is established on March 15 2015. Rail networks under this flagship is scattered all across Los Sengas, and this division also assisted in multiple infrastructural projects, including but not limited to the Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals and Mayler Airport.

Incidents

Upper Rover Station Destruction Incident

On April 29 2017, due to misuse of commands from an administrator, Upper Rover Station was nearly completely destroyed. As a result, Nazca Railway conducted emergency repair works in accordance to backup blueprints. The station completed restoration the next day. This incident later became the inspiration for its Station Characteristic.

Glacier Station Destruction Incident

On July 7 2018 21:50 (UTC +8), due to misuse of commands from an administrator, Glacier Station was closed for over three hours, with , which only ran between the aforementioned station and Ingress Flatland Station at the time, being put out of service. also terminated services at Spike End Station, and players also went to Glacier Station to assess damages until another administrator expelled the players from the site. 20 minutes after the accident, Nazca Railway has announced the destructuion of Glacier Station on a public notice. The station completed restoration on 1am the next day, and the administrator involved issued a letter of apology for this incident.

Future Development

Nazca Railway will build more new stations and establish more new lines in the future, as well as enhancing and maintaining the existing stations and services in the process of becoming the largest Minecraft Railway System in the world. safeHtml:
The '''Nazca Railway 2020+ Plans''' is a Development Plan proposed by Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division starting from 2020 and is announced on January 9 of the Same Year.

Development Plan Link

  • https://www.facebook.com/nazcarailway/posts/2610518932401146

Original Text (In Chinese)

洛聖加納鐵 Los Sengas NR

仲記唔記得納鐵喺上年年尾嘅時候會公佈「納鐵 2020+ 計劃」？而家正式計劃出爐喇，而呢個計劃係淨係針對洛聖加納鐵，而未必一定喺 2020 年內完成，如果納鐵會去其他地方就會另行通知。

如果 tl;dr 嘅話可以睇下圖雞精版㗎。

1. 大都會總站地下行人隧道及第六至九期擴建。

1a. 地下行人隧道：

現時大都會總站有 4 個行人隧道區域，納鐵計劃喺紅場同大都會之間嘅區域、都河站以東同都泉站東南嘅區域建立 3 個新嘅總站行人隧道。

1b. 第六至九期擴建：

喺現有嘅第四期結構中預留嘅「樞紐鐵路白羊綫」月台將會撥入第四期嘅主要結構，並且改由一條新嘅速管鐵路代行。

跟著喺第四期同層嘅北面會喺未來擴建第六至七期：第六期將會有一個全新嘅大堂同一組側式月台，俾未來樞紐鐵路白羊綫之用，咁樣大堂可以加入更多同樞紐鐵路有關嘅設施同方便控制人流；第七期會喺第六期嘅北面，會另建四組島式月台俾未來 2 條新嘅標準鐵路綫途經。

第八同九期會喺地面：第八期喺地面大堂嘅北面嘅路軌交匯處之上，將會興建全新嘅巴士總站同多層停車場，巴士總站預計會預留多於一百條巴士綫途徑，納鐵亦會承建同改善附近嘅道路網迎合未來流量；第九期喺第八期北面，派比安路之上嘅高架結構，俾未來嘅區內鐵路系統用 (第 3 項)。

2. 總部第一階段：站體及車廠

納鐵嘅總部經過多年嘅準備終於有具體嘅文字規劃，為方便發展同搵緊急替代方案，總部嘅建設會分段形式建造。總部位置落實喺「優托管制區及極光群島」建造，大體上嘅設計會以「亞特蘭蒂斯神話」作為主調，會有多個人工島作唔同用途。

第一階段係「優托站 Centopia Station」及納鐵總車廠，會係獨立一個南北藥丸型人工島嶼，初部估計長大約 3 公里；車站會先落成高架部分，即 10 號盜鈴綫同地區捷運同大堂部分；亦會建造車廠同車輛通道。

3. 成立區內鐵路系統

繼標準同次標準鐵路之後，納鐵再成立新嘅鐵路模式：區內鐵路系統。解釋：如果當標準鐵路係一分之一嘅鐵路嘅話，納鐵嘅次標準鐵路係四分之三個標準鐵路嘅規模，區內鐵路嘅設定會係標準鐵路嘅二分之一，未至於輕型鐵路(納鐵視為四分之一)。

而同次標準唔同嘅地方係，區內鐵路系統係同(次)標準分開，一個區域由一至幾條區內路綫所組成，編號為「英文字母」帶「數字」，例如「A1 號綫」，唔會有獨立名稱，而英文字母就係分區系統編號，綫號唔會獨立存在 (速管使用獨英文字母)，納鐵現正規劃市中心、尖岸同優托嘅系統。

4. 正式車站介紹影片

除咗每集完結嘅介紹同行車影片之外，小編想以一個比較認真嘅態度介紹每個納鐵嘅車站，除咗大都會總站會分開拍之外，小編應該會順著落成次序拍，亦會分季集，按車站初落成時所在集數同季數而定。

5. 標準及速管鐵路全面使用車站號碼及方向系統

呢個都唔特別需要多講不過都要寫低，自從納鐵喺第三季第七集之後就陸續為現有車站更新指示牌，因為納鐵對於車站號碼嘅研究已經成熟，搵到一個度身訂造嘅號碼系統，呢個系統除咗號碼之外都有分上下行嘅標記，俾乘客更方便知道自己喺上行站定下行站，往上行定下行都能夠一目了然。

6. 納鐵宋收錄至 1 萬字

呢個係一個好長遠嘅目標，而家有 4 千鬆啲字，未來幾年小編會為納鐵獨有嘅字型擴充字庫，雖然實際用途唔大，不過都係為興趣啫。

English Translation of Full Text

Los Sengas NR

Do you still remember the time when NR says that the "Nazca Railway 2020+ Plans" will be announced? Now, the plans are officially out. This plan only focuses on Los Sengas NR, and does not necessarily have to be completed in 2020.

tl;dr? Look at the concentrated version below.

1. Metropolis Terminal and Underground Walkway expansion:

1a. Underground Walkway expansion:

Currently, there are four zones in the Metropolis Terminal Underground Walkway. Nazca Railway plans to construct three additional Underground Walkways, one between and , one to the east of Metro River Station, and one to the southeast of Metro Spring Station.

1b. Phases VI to IX:

The existing reserved platforms for the Hub Railway will be distributed to the current Phase IV Structure and handed over to a New Veloduct.

Phases VI and VII will be constructed directly to the north of Phase IV. Phase VI will feature an entirely new set of side paltforms and a new concourses for the future . This way, the new concourse can insert new Hub Railway-related facilities and facilitate passenger flow. Moreover, Phase VII will be constructed directly to the norht of Phase VI, and four sets of Island Platforms will be constructed for two new future Standard Railway Lines.

Phases VIII and IX will be on the ground level. Phase VIII will be located to the north of the Ground Concourse above the track intersection. A new Bus Terminus and a multi-storey car park will be constructed, with the Bus Terminal having a projected capacity of 100 bus routes. Nazca Railway will also be the main contractor for the construction and improvement works of the new roads. Finally, Phase IX will be located to the north of Phase VIII and will be an elevated structure on top of Prapiroon Road for future Local Rapid Transit use. More details of this plan will be highlighted at the Third Point.

2. Nazca Railway Headquarters Phase I: Station and Depot:

After years of preparations, the Nazca Railway Headquarters is finally ready to go to the stage of planning on paper. For the sake of convenience and contingency plans, the Headquarters will be built in different phases. The Headquarters will be located at the Centopia Area and Aurora Isles, and will be themed after the legend of Atlantis. Multiple Artificial islands will also be constructed for different uses.

Phase I of Nazca Railway Headquarters involve the construction of Centopia Station and the Main Nazca Railway Depot. Centopia will be a pill-shaped, north-south oriented island that will be 3km long. The elevated part, or the , Local Rapid Transit Parts and the Concourse of the station, will first be constructed alongside the Depot and the vehicular access.

3. Establish Local Rapid Transits (LRTs):

After the Standard Railway and the Sub-Standard Railway, Nazca Railway will once again establish a new mode of transport known as the Local Rapid Transit (LRT). If the Standard Railway is considered a portion, the Sub-Standard Railway is considered three quarters, and the LRT will be half a portion, which is in turn more than the Light Railway, which is considered to be a quarter.

Unlike Sub-Standard Railways, LRTs run separately with the Standard Railway lines, and an area or a District will consist of several LRT Lines, with the code of such lines being an alphabet followed by a Number, say for instance '''Line A1'''. There will not be independent names on Local Rapid Transit Lines as the alphabet represents the code of the area. Moreover, the nubmer would not exist on its own either, as Veloducts use Alphabets as well. The Downtown, Shore Tip and Centopia Local Rapid Transit are currently under planning.

4. NR Station Tour Clips:

Exccept for the Station Introduction Videos filmed at the end of every episode, Nazca Railway also wants to introduce its stations properly. Besides of Metropolis Terminal, which will be filmed separately due to the scale of the station, the clips will be filmed in Chronological Order, and Spilt based on its Seasons and Episodes, depending on the time at which this station began services.

5. Full Implementation of the Nazca Railway Station Numbering and Directional System on all Standard Railway and Veloduct lines:

While this point does not have to be explicitly specified, it is nonetheless important. Since Season 3, Episode 7, the stations are now undergoing upgrades for its existing stations as Nazca Railway now has a complete study over the Station Numbering, and found a Numbering System fully fit for Nazca Railway. Besides of the Station Number, the Up Direction and Down Direction Stations will also be split clearly for the sake of Passengers.

6. NR Song Reaching 10'000 words:

This Target is a long-term Target. NR Song currently only has around 4'000 words. However, the word database will be extended. While this does not have practical applications, it is nonetheless an interest of mine.

Current Progress

  • The four Island Platforms proposed for Phase VII of Metropolis Terminal has been rescheduled for Phase VI and constructed for two new Standard Railway Strategic Lines, namely and .
  • While Centopia and Centopia Depot have already commenced services on July 8 2020, the former (Centopia) had undergone changes in plans during construction with the regards that all the Standard Railway and Veloduct Platforms, Elevated or underground, as well as the connecting taxi stations, have been built. However, the Part of the Local Rapid Transit Section and facilities have yet to be constructed.
  • The first Local Rapid Transit System (Shore Tip LRT) was confirmed to be built on August 23 2020.
  • The Nazca Railway Station Numbering and Directional System is completely implemented on all Nazca Railway Stations on June 19 2020.

Original Text (In Chinese)

洛聖加納鐵 Los Sengas NR

納斯卡鐵路洛聖加分部近月同多個地方嘅發展人員商討之後，納鐵決定未來將會推出一系列嘅新鐵路項目，以下係發展大綱。

甲：發展階段單位 Units of Development Milestone

-----

洛聖加納鐵由第一日發展以嚟都係用「季 Season」、「集 Episode」同「章 Chapters」作為主要發展階段，間唔中喺兩集之間會有「外傳」。

納鐵會喺第 3 季完成之後，將會喺第 4 季開始嘅時候介紹「第 1 部 (Saga 1)」，小編之前講過，呢個只係開始。當然，每季仍然會保持著有 19 集唔多唔少。

乙：路綫延伸及新路綫計劃 Line Extensions and New Lines

-----

納鐵已經同唔同嘅地方發展人員達成共識，將會喺唔同地方加入納鐵服務，興建新車站、路綫延伸同加入新路綫。可能又要需時幾年時間完成，不過未完成應該會又有新一疊項目等著開始㗎喇。

路綫延伸：

- 3 號大城綫 Urban Line 會向北延伸一個站，並喺「近北閘口站 Intus Aquilo Gateway」同「隆永頓站 Longwington Station」之間加一個站，配合 40 號新綫發展。

- 4 號新華綫 New Edward Line 西行會由「湃汸角站 Python Delta Station」延伸至「滄崖站 Le Monde Station」至霞英區。東行會延伸至糸彗區嘅東南面，同 22 號糸彗綫 Cometsilk Line 轉乘多一次。

- 5 號球場綫 Stadium Line 西行會由「近西閘口站 Intus Occident Gateway」延伸至啄木大陸嘅西岸，預計會有 6 個新車站。

- 5C 號杹政綫 Xofa Crescent 會重新定義服務定位，唔會再望著上行同 5 號球場綫 Stadium Line 進行第二次轉乘，而會改為一條由主綫向外延伸嘅支綫，並會改名叫 5A 號杹政綫 Xofa Line。未來會向南至霞英地區。

- 6 號群島綫 Arcgo Line 西行會由「單盛墟站 Dansein Market Station」繼續延伸至北單盛，中間會途經幾個新車站，包括一個新嘅閘口站。遠期發展會喺東北面延伸至「白海站 Arctic Sea Station」。

- 7 號森水綫 Luxter Line 東行會由「沙燕檢查站 Sand Martin Checkpoint」會繼續沿著育華區北岸延伸至「雛菊島站 Daisy Island Station」。

- 8 號法瓶綫 Flask Line 嘅下行會由「冰川站 Glacier Station」延伸兩個站至「海平島站 Peacean Island Station」同 7A 號沙花綫轉乘。

- 9 號千宿綫 Kinight Line 會由「德利臺站 Darey Terrace Station」南延，會經過自由海峽進入霞英，中間會同 17 號綠洲灣綫 Oasis Bay Line、32 號明眸綫 Vision Line 同速管鐵路 Epilson Line 綫轉乘。

- 10 號盜鈴綫 Daring Line 兩邊都會有延綫計劃。北面會延伸至北單盛，南面會進入霞英區。

The '''Nazca Railway 2021 Plans''' is a Development Plan proposed by Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division for 2021. It is announced on the Nazca Railway Facebook Page on December 31 2020.

Development Plan Link

https://www.facebook.com/nazcarailway/posts/3490001907786173

Original Text (In Chinese)

Los Sengas NR 洛聖加納鐵

納斯卡鐵路即將踏入發展嘅第十個年頭，而家公佈來年，即係 2021 年嘅發展大綱。

總部第二階段： 優托車站、優托車廠同優托人工島已經喺今年 (2020) 年中完成建設，來年納鐵會繼續優托嘅建設，包括會喺島嶼嘅南北方設置多個停車場、喺車站嘅南面會興建酒店、車廠嘅東北同東南面新增 2 個公園、車廠東面會新增海濱長廊同商店街。另外，將會成立優托地區捷運，同 1B 號烏托邦綫(一期)連接二十二中部同優托。

成立策略綫系統： 大都會總站將會引入一對全新嘅路綫，項目總名「策略綫」，加強大都會總站同周邊地區嘅鐵路接駁。呢兩條路綫正式命名為 - 27 號飛馬綫 Pegasus Line - 28 號鳳凰綫 Phoenix Line 呢兩條路綫走綫會為呈「X」形，但喺大都會總站交會之外，喺市中心嘅東面同西面都會有跨月台轉乘同行車轉乘。預計初期投入服務時候受惠地區會有：市中心、沙花、卡城、後生、三蹄、綠洲灣、法瓶同守時。

重新繪製線上地圖路綫圖： 納鐵將於 2021 年喺駐服洛聖加嘅線上地圖標記重新繪製，以統一類別顯示納鐵嘅路綫同車站，取代現有以多個類別顯示單一路綫同車站。為未來加入其他鐵路喺線上地圖路綫圖鋪路。

第二階段標識更新： 實際上，呢項工作已經喺半年前開始，一直以緩慢速度更新指示板。而家納鐵正式將呢項工作納入來年處理嘅項目：第二階段標識更新包括更換所有閘機嘅抬頭恭祝用指示板同埋黑底路綫方向牌。

當然納鐵喺 2021 年會發展嘅地方唔會咁少，亦都會有機會變化，但係呢個列表係納鐵希望喺來年會做同埋完成嘅工作，令納鐵系統更加完整同統一。

English Translation of Full Text

Los Sengas NR

Nazca Railway will enter its tenth year of development, and now is the time to announce the development plans for the upcoming year, or the Nazca Railway 2021 Plans.

Headquarters Phase II:

Centopia Station, Centopia Depot and the Centopia Artificial Island have all completed construction in the middle of this year (2020), and the next year will see continued construction in Centopia, including multiple car-parks at both ends of the island, as well as a hotel at the south of the Station, two new parks to the northeast and southeast of the Depot, along with a new Promenade and a New Shopping Street. Moreover, the Centopia LRT system will be established alongside Phase I, which would connect the center of Twenty-Second Continent with Centopia

Establishing the Strategic Railway System:

A new pair of Railway Lines will be introduced to the Metropolis Terminal, and this project is known as the '''Strategic Lines'''. The aim of the Strategic Lines are to enhance the connectivity of Metropolis Terminal with its surrounding districts. The lines will be named: - Line 27: , and - Line 28:

The two lines will form a Cross-Shape, but besides of the Metropolis Terminal, two brand-new stations featuring cross-platform interchanges between these two lines will also be built to the West and East of Downtown.The New Stations to the West and the East are Sincerity Cove Station and Candor Plains Station respectively, but the latter is located at Katadelphia and does not feature cross-platform interchange.</ref> The project initial service areas of the Strategic Lines include Downtown, Sava, Katadelphia, Youngsters, TriPaw, Oasis Bay, Flask and Punctual.

Redrawing Online Map Markers:

Nazca Railway will begin re-drawing all Online Map Markers starting from 2021, so that all Nazca Railway Lines and Stations will be classified into the same type instead of opening one type for each line and station. This can pave the way for installing markers for lines from Other Railway Operators onto the [http://projectnazca.nhz.hk/map.php Online Map].

Completing Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works:

While this project has already commenced half a year ago, the replacement works of the signs have been fairly slow. However, starting from this year, Nazca Railway will increase the pace of the SignPicture Updating Works Phase II, including replacing the "Welcome Sign" above the entry gates and the Black Background Directional Signs.

While Nazca Railway would not only develop things from this list, and things on this list are also subject to changes, this list is nonetheless a wish from Nazca Railway in order to make Nazca Railway system more integrated and complete.

title: Nazca Railway 2022 Part 2 Development Plans
safeHtml:
The '''Nazca Railway 2022 Part 2 Development Plans''' is a Development Plan proposed by Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division for Nazca Railway Development starting from 2022. It is announced on the Nazca Railway Facebook Page on May 17 2022.

Development Plan Link

https://www.facebook.com/nazcarailway/posts/4985909984862017

Original Text (In Chinese)

洛聖加納鐵 Los Sengas NR

(少說話、多數事)

【納鐵 2022 下發展大綱】

2022 年預計將會係納斯卡鐵路完成洛聖加分部第 3 季嘅一年。

// 首先，納鐵由第 4 季開始唔會再公開以數字描述季度，取而代之嘅會係佢嘅發展代號，第 4 季嘅發展代號為：

- 納斯卡鐵路：四季之交 Nazca Railway: The Four Seasons

《納斯卡鐵路：四季之交》(或《四季之交 TFS》) 會為第 1 部 (Saga) 嘅首篇，第 1 部嘅全稱為

- 納斯卡鐵路與二十四寶座 Nazca Railway and the Twenty-four Thrones

(你哋可以略稱「廿四寶座」或者英文 "the 24 Thrones" 或者「G1」)

// 優托嘅建造計劃會由 2021 年計劃押後至今個下半年至 2023 年上半年左右，不過為確保計劃唔會變相終止，納鐵決定開始第 4 季之前必須完成優托島嘅設施，同埋完成所有總部其他人工島嶼嘅填海同埋道路網，包括優托島嘅南北公路出口接駁、各個島嶼嘅連接路同埋來往杹政嘅連接路。

// 第 3 季最後兩集嘅發展內容以下：

第 18 集：

納鐵將會成立 28 號鳳凰綫 Phoenix Line，先發展東面嘅上行走綫，確定途經現有嘅車站包括：

- 「青環站 Cyan Loop Station」、

- 「坪率站 Candor Plains Station」、

- 「瓶仄站 Fosina Station」、

- 「瓶北站 Flask North Station」、

- 「瓶東檢查站 Flask East Checkpoint」、

- 「矩時灣站 Rectime Bay Station」、

- 「暖山站 Warm Cairn Station」、

- 「釘灣檢查站 Nail Bight Checkpoint」同

- 「尖矢站 Arrowhead Station」。

第 19 集：

鳳凰綫發展西面下行走綫，確定途經現有嘅車站包括：

- 「誠摯灣站 Sincerity Cove Station」、

- 「義忠灣站 Bonyal Bay Station」、

- 「維拉北站 Vayler North Station」、

- 「三凹站 The Three Pass Station」同

- 「西灘檢查站 West Shoal Checkpoint」。

// 為統一速管鐵路嘅命名同北約 (NATO) 音標一致，以下路綫將會改名：

Epsilon Line 綫改叫 Echo Line 綫，

Fox Line 綫改叫 Foxtrot Line 綫。

// 拍攝納鐵頻道「車站遊覽」短片系列 (非 YouTube Shorts)。

// 持續發展工程包括：

- 豎立納鐵車站直幡、

- 為現有車站新增挑戰同

- 完成舊有車站圖鑑卡片之後進行 N. R. L. S. H. 計劃

// 下一份大綱會係有關《四季之交》嘅發展略要。

Los Sengas NR

Nazca Railway 2022 Part 2 Development Plans

2022 is the year in which Nazca Railway is projected to complete Season 3 Development.

// First off, starting from Season 4, Nazca Railway will no longer use numbers to describe the Season of development. Instead, a code will be used to represent the season. The Development Code for Season 4 is:

- Nazca Railway: The Four Seasons

- Nazca Railway and the Twenty-four Thrones

(You may refer to Saga 1 as "The 24 Thrones" or Simply "G1".)

// The development of Centopia will be delayed from 2021 to the end of this year or the first half of 2023. - Cyan Loop Station,

- Flask East Checkpoint,

will develop the Down Direction Route at the west. The known Stations include:

- Bonyal Bay Station,

- will be renamed '''Echo Line''', and

// Continuous Development Plans include:

- Erecting Station Banners,

- Add Station Gauntlets to Existing Stations, and:

- Overtake the N.R.L.S.H. Plan after creating the NR Dex for all existing stations.

// The Next Development Plan will be related to "The Four Seasons".

title: Nazca Railway By-Laws
safeHtml:
• "Nazca Railway By-laws" (English Version)

Extracted and revised from “Public Facilities Regulation in the Server,” 29th version on December 31st, 2024, effective on January 1st, 2025 Hong Kong time.<br />

A: Citation

  • These by-laws may be cited as the Nazca Railway By-laws or NR By-laws.<br /> 

B: Interpretation

  • “station”: any structure with “Nazca Railway”, “NR”, “納斯卡鐵路” or “納鐵” marking with station name;
  • “premises”: any station structure stated above with “Nazca Railway”, “NR”, “納 斯卡鐵路”, “NR” etc.;
  • “platform (train)”: a platform with block of iron as the main texture, and/or color bar next to the track, handing board with number, line and directions in inverted trapezium next to, in front of or behind the track, yellow lines, automatic platform gates and/or platform screen doors at platform edge;
  • “track”: all rail tracks connected and extended from NR platform. Tracks behind the platform yellow lines, gates or screen doors are included; any structure next to the track such as emergency platform, railings, signs, lighting systems, pillars, internal/external tunnel walls etc.;
  • “train”: all passenger-minecarts within Minecraft NR track areas;
  • “sign”: all signage used within or for NR premises, including signs made from Minecraft wooden text signs, SignPicture mod signs, and item frames containing ImageOnMap plugin maps;
  • “passenger” excluding “self”: any person who are using train service within NR station, platform or track area;
  • “passenger” of “self”: Holder of a single or multiple Minecraft account(s) using single or multiple IP address(es) is considered as single passenger;
  • “personnel”: or refer as “staff”, all individuals work for NR or permitted by NR;
  • “shop”: or refer as “NR Shops” or “store”, means all shops within NR premises, labeled as “NR Shops” and a line of shop number;
  • “borrower”: all individuals who borrow NR shops;
  • “inn”: or refer as “NR Inns”, means the area of an array of rooms or buildings managed by NR, for passengers to stay in;
  • “resident”: passenger who owns a room/unit in an NR Inn

C: General Regulations

1. Must abide local server rules:<br />

2. No unauthorized action can be done within NR areas including railway premises, platforms and track areas etc. such as:

  • a. Los Sengas Division: The Ten General Rules of the Project Nazca Main Server;
  • b. Terracept Division: The Ten General Rules of the Project Nazca Archive Server;
  • a. Adding, removing or attempting to add or remove any structure;
  • b. Placing liquid or fluid;
  • c. Extracting liquid or fluid from any NR non-designated vessel;
  • d. Littering;
  • e. Altering or attempting to alter any sign content;
  • f. Conducting trading operations and/or advertising;
  • g. Using Mounts;
  • h. Bringing Animals;
  • i. Equipping elytra;
  • j. Flying;
  • k. Using status potions;
  • l. Being invisible (including using spectator mode);
  • m. Placing or using boats;
  • n. Wearing Dragon Head;
  • o. Doing parkour;

D: Passenger Behaviors

3. Do comply all instructions from NR staff and signs in railway premises;<br /> 4. Do enter and exit the station via designated entrances; <br /> 5. Do enter and exit the station entry gate areas via designated gates;<br />

6. Do set and use personal teleport service without permission ONLY at designated NR Inter-station Teleportation spot;<br />

7. Do queue up for using elevators and short range teleporters; <br /> 8. Do not use any NR devices or enter staff only area unless they are opened publicly;<br />

9. Do not add, block or interfere any lighting or sign system;<br /> 10. Rules for automated permission of NR sign usage at non-NR premises by third party:

11. Do not obstruct, flutter or insult other passengers from using any NR service;<br />

12. Do not use any noise-emitting device such as note block within railway premises in any mean unless approved;

  • a. This by-law does not apply when gate area is not enclosed;
  • a. '''Do not use any Worldedit teleport commands inside NR station, platform or track areas; or accessing or leaving NR station, platform or track areas;'''
  • a. It is allowed to enter stations and its areas which is under construction without permission when at least one exit is clearly defined, but interfering construction in any way is not allowed;
  • a. Under the rules of local server, if passenger is allowed to use creative mode, they are allowed to copy any sign at NR premises;
  • b. Do not handhold any sign containing SignPicture mod signs unless copying or placing them;
  • c. Do not jettison SignPicture mod signs at NR premises unless the passenger has a clear intention to transfer the sign to one another, if the receiver failed to pick up, the giver should retrieve the sign at once;
  • d. Displaying NR signs at non-NR premises should only be used for vicinity location acknowledgement and directional guidance; collection or related purposes are not allowed;
  • e. Storing NR signs inside a container at non-NR premises is allowed;
  • f. Do not download any NR SignPicture mod sign via any method except using the mod itself;
  • g. Do not modify any NR sign, especially SignPicture mod signs;
  • h. NR is not responsible for notifying of any sign content change maybe due to link removal or update which are at outside NR premises; <br /> 
  • a. '''Do not carry Worldedit //regen operation within 16 meters from any NR premises or track areas, regardless the height/depth or user’s identity;'''

E: Track and Railway Service

13. Please use owned minecart, or claim a minecart from a designated minecart claim area;<br /> 14. Station passengers must board or alight via platform; <br /> 15. NR strongly suggests using depart routine for multiple departures;<br /> 16. Do not control any provided platform screen door or automatic platform gate while not departing from that platform;<br /> 17. Passengers should be patient for the whole depart routine operation. Passengers can press the depart routine reset button below the depart routine button or leave the station manually if the waiting time is longer than usual. <br /> 18.  If either the depart routine button or the depart routine reset button does not work in a normal manner, please seek the person in charge of NR to handle;<br /> 19. Passengers should not trespass the yellow line or platform doors when “please stand back from xx” or “xx is/are closing” is announcing or platform lights are flashing; <br /> 20. Do not place trains in front of a moving train within platform passenger track zone;<br /> 21. Do not ride backwards; <br /> 22. Do not board, alight or teleport away (not in emergency) between stations or the train has not completely stopped; <br /> 23. Do not change speed (not in emergency) outside platform area;<br /> 24. Passengers must not flutter other individuals and vice versa;<br /> 25. Unless specified in emergency platforms or special signs, track areas are only for passenger trains;<br /> 26. Emergency platforms are only for passengers who encounter an accident;<br /> 27. Passengers who encounter an accident between stations, are allowed to place trains and continue the journey when the situation is safe, or seek assistance from NR staff;<br /> 28. Mounts are not allowed in the track area;<br /> 29. No-fly zone within 15 meters above opened tracks;<br /> 30. Do not switch or alter any NR track and their automatic or manual switches;<br /> 31. Do not ride unopened sections. Whether passengers can ride a specific section can be decided by the following top-down hierarchy:

  • a. On-scene instruction from NR staff;
  • b. Platform information boards regarding the section (overhead board is not included);
  • c. NR official Facebook page or website press releases;
  • d. NR page or website system maps；

F: Shop Borrowing and Service

32. Passengers can request NR to borrow a non-borrowed/owned shop;<br />

33. Passengers can only borrow one shop at a time;<br /> 34. Passengers can only borrow one shop per station;<br /> 35. Passengers can only borrow one shop after 10 days (from 7) from the last shop borrow-ship; <br /> 36. Passengers should complete setting up the previously applied shop before borrowing the new one;<br /> 37. All names and products from shops are not allowed to use existing names or nicknames other than the borrower. If more than one borrower using the same name or using exotic product names of the borrower are found, each side should raise evidence to claim ownership;

38. Shop or product names are not allowed to use Nazca Railway related names such as “Nazca”, “納斯卡” etc. without approval no matter the names are claimed in other meanings;<br /> 39. Borrowers should only use Creative Mode within their shop area;<br /> 40. Unless specified, borrowers are allowed to change one-block layer of floor, wall and ceiling;<br /> 41. Borrowers are not allowed to add or remove any structure outside their shop area;<br /> 42. Borrowers are not allowed to remove or change the shop sign. The format of NR Shop signs are “XXX-YY”, where “XXX” is the station code and “YY” is the shop code;<br /> 43. Borrowers are allowed to place plaques at the top of the shop entrance;

  • a. Requirements for applying themed shop:
  • ai. Borrowed no less than 2 regular NR Shops;
  • aii. Related business experience in server is a plus.
  • a. Los Sengas Division: Borrowers who owned permanent corporation are allowed to use their shop/product names;

G: Inn Ownership

44. Passengers can request NR to own a non-owned room/unit from an NR Inn;<br /> 45. Passengers can only own no more than two non-owned room/unit from an NR Inn;<br />

46. Passengers can request NR to own a non-owned parking space from an NR Inn;<br /> 47. Fresh residents have a priority to apply a parking space at the same inn, this right expires if the resident passes;<br /> 48. Unless specified, residents are allowed to change on-block layer of floor and ceiling, and any internal walls;<br /> 49. Residents are not allowed to add or remove any structure outside their room/unit area;<br /> 50. Residents are not allowed to remove or change the room/unit or parking space sign. The format of NR Inns room/unit signs are “XXX-YY”, where “XXX” is the inn code and “YY” is the room/unit code. The format of NR Inns parking space signs are “XXX-PYY”, where “XXX” is the inn code, “P” stands for Parking and “YY” is the parking space code.<br />

  • a. Passengers can only own one NR Inn room/unit per NR Inn;
  • b. Passengers must apply for check-out of at least one NR Inn room/unit before requesting another NR Inn room/unit if their quota is full;

H: Passenger Asset Migration

51. Passengers can apply for asset migration to let NR personnel update the assets for passengers with a number of conditions;<br/>

52. Only NR Shops and NR Inns can be applied for asset migration:<br/>

  • a. Passenger should list out all assets to be applied;<br/>

53. Passenger who applies for asset migration should only be changing of names, accounts transfer is not accepted:<br/>

  • a. One exemption is transferring assets from a hacked account. Passenger should proof ownerships of both accounts in order to be entertained;<br/>

54. After the application is accepted and handled, the passenger will receive a cooldown before next asset migration application, the cooldown calculation as follows:

  • a. A mandatory cooldown of 4 weeks,
  • b. Additional 1 week for each applied and handled asset,
  • c. This cooldown period does not affect other cooldowns;<br/>

I: Global Compliance Request

55. When “Test Stage” is in effect, please refrain from performing the following actions at the server until the “Test Stage” is announced over:

The purpose of this measure is to ensure the server’s stability for allowing Nazca Railway to pass the Quality Assurance before opening a track section.

  • a. Teleporting by any means;
  • b. Operating Worldedit;
  • c. High-speed movement including but not limited to:
  • i. Riding trains;
  • ii. Riding horses (with or without customizations);
  • iii. Flying with elytra;
  • iv. Flying with Essentials “speed” command degree higher than 2 (sprint included).
